platform.componentPreviewPolicy: Runtime components are native Slint. This sidecar records source and behavior; it contains no fabricated HTML/CSS component assets.
platform.units: Slint logical pixels. Client captures and Slint scale overrides do not establish physical Windows DPI transitions.

accent.purpose: Primary action, focus, draft path and selected keyboard group.

caption-close.purpose: Scoped red hover/focus fill for the native caption Close action.

on-caption-close.purpose: White SVG ink on the scoped Close hover/focus fill.

derivation.muted: mix(canvas, foreground, 0.70), falling back to foreground if contrast on hover is below 4.5:1
derivation.on-accent: Black or white, whichever has greater contrast against accent

validation: Invalid or partial edits retain the last valid appearance preview
Save persists the local appearance draft
appearance.persistence: Separate versioned ui-settings.json preserves app-settings.json readability for older protected helpers; normal save failures retain rollback and concurrent-change checks.
appearance.authority: Appearance preview changes no profile, hardware, recovery or startup permission.

nativeComponents.name: Primary native action
nativeComponents.description: Accent/on-accent action with common control geometry, keyboard activation and focus.
nativeComponents.states: Primary retains accent/on-accent; pressed and keyboard focus use an on-accent boundary.

nativeComponents.name: Secondary native action
nativeComponents.description: Control/ink action with tonal hover and focus.
nativeComponents.states: Hover and pressed use hover/ink; pressed boundary is accent. Disabled uses surface/quiet.

nativeComponents.name: Native text field
nativeComponents.description: Native TextInput with caret, selection, IME, clipped horizontal editing, clipboard/context actions and Undo.
nativeComponents.states: Focus uses an accent boundary. Appearance errors retain the previous valid preview.

nativeComponents.name: Native selector
nativeComponents.description: Common closed field with bounded, scrollable, wrapped choices.
nativeComponents.states: Open arrows/Home/End move and reveal the pending variable-height row. Enter/click commits; Escape cancels.

nativeComponents.name: Sidebar navigation
nativeComponents.description: Persistent 160 logical px sidebar with equal 44 logical px Overview/Cooling/Lighting targets and Settings pinned at the bottom.
nativeComponents.states: Selected tonal fill, accent marker/icon and full-target focus boundary. Overview stays selected while its GPU curve is open.

nativeComponents.name: Collapsible section
nativeComponents.description: Flat surface heading with a drawn chevron, focus and keyboard activation; help appears on demand.

nativeComponents.name: Connected curve canvas
nativeComponents.description: Actual connected Path for accent draft and muted opening reference, with a textual legend. Explicit New opens a fresh driver-factory GPU curve without inheriting an offset, cached edit or history; startup stays on Overview. Cancel preserves the previous draft. Keyboard focus transfers after the selector closes. This is a preview reset, not a hardware write. Visible GPU range mode supports pointer and numeric selection; Equalize changes selected points only in one Undo step, with driver/order validation and an empty-range guard.
nativeComponents.states: Axes are outside the clipped plot; markers and pointer input share plot coordinates in software and femtovg rendering.

nativeComponents.name: Schematic keyboard
nativeComponents.description: Original QWERTZ/QWERTY geometry with draft zone tint, color underline and selected-group boundary.
nativeComponents.states: Independent WASD = wire 3; left = wire 2; middle = wire 1; numpad/right = wire 0 including adjacent keys. Four group buttons provide keyboard access. Full-width schematic, not per-key RGB or measured LED boundaries; compact Preview badge replaces body explanations.
nativeComponents.behavior: Picker/hex, On/Off and RGB-value brightness remain drafts until guarded Apply/readback. Reset and exit protection preserve the transaction.

nativeComponents.name: Native brightness control
nativeComponents.description: Accent track/thumb, focus boundary and numeric alternative for RGB-value brightness.
nativeComponents.states: 0–100 in single steps, with arrows, Home/End and semantic slider actions. No firmware master-brightness byte is invented.

nativeComponents.name: Shared color field
nativeComponents.description: 276x36 color/HEX well opening the common staged editor.

nativeComponents.name: HSV and HEX dialog
nativeComponents.description: Before/selection preview, SV plane, hue, sixteen swatches, valid HEX acceptance, cancel and visible keyboard focus.

nativeComponents.name: Visual palette choices
nativeComponents.description: Five equal source-backed palette previews with checked selection.

nativeComponents.name: Custom native caption
nativeComponents.description: Frameless owner with custom caption; WindowMoveArea drag, double-click maximize and native right-click system menu.
nativeComponents.states: Native resize border only while restored; Close follows existing tray/exit policy.

nativeComponents.name: Caption action
nativeComponents.description: 48 × 40 logical px action with original SVG minimize, maximize/restore or Close icon.
nativeComponents.states: Theme ink and hover/focus feedback; Close uses scoped red/white hover and focus. Space/Enter and semantic action activation.

nativeComponents.name: Contextual group selector
nativeComponents.description: Equal 36 logical px contextual targets retain selected fill, focus outline and hit geometry.

nativeComponents.name: Result notification
nativeComponents.description: Bounded result overlay with wrapped scrollable body, dismissal and Details. Replaces only the status/error strip.
nativeComponents.states: Errors persist. Normal success uses a six-second timer while the window is visible; hiding or opening Details stops it, and visible return or closing Details rearms it. Loading/telemetry do not become success messages.

nativeComponents.name: Selectable details dialog
nativeComponents.description: Bounded scrimmed dialog with native read-only TextEdit for selecting/copying diagnostics.
nativeComponents.states: Close is initially focused; Tab cycles between text and Close. Escape closes; focus returns to the invoking Details action.
nativeComponents.verificationBoundary: The native TextEdit provides copy behavior. The documentation pass does not claim a live system-clipboard copy test.

nativeComponents.name: Save before preset switch
nativeComponents.description: Save, Discard and Cancel protect an edited preset; Cancel is initially focused.
nativeComponents.states: Save must succeed before the target is loaded. Save failure keeps the current editor/selection. A separate recovery warning cannot erase successful Save-and-switch intent.

documentationEvidence.scope: Native source and isolated client captures establish the recorded composition. Software interaction tests are owned by Validation. No physical DPI, hardware policy uptake, cooling handover, lifecycle or total-tray qualification is implied.
documentationEvidence.finishReview: Independent final native review: all 30 listed captures opened; six screenshot findings and named cooling view resolved. Software/UI scope only; physical policy/LED/lifecycle acceptance is not inferred.

windowLifecycle.presentation: One deferred software-only partial-render-cache reset and actual redraw on window return; the temporary snapshot is dropped.
windowLifecycle.preservation: No window/model recreation, idle repaint timer or periodic full redraw. Existing drafts, selection, caret and Undo remain.
windowLifecycle.verification: Check owned, unobscured shown client pixels after minimize/restore and tray return before requesting an MCP snapshot; snapshots can reset software caches and mask missing presentation.
windowLifecycle.scope: Slint scale overrides and native client checks do not establish physical Windows DPI, hardware lifecycle or total-tray-resource qualification.

manualApply.queue: The latest manual mode/preset intent replaces waiting targets. One executor lets active hardware work reach a safe completion boundary; no controller kill or mid-write cancellation.
manualApply.results: Obsolete completion generations do not overwrite the current result or record obsolete successful selection.
manualApply.recovery: Restore and verify a pending original checkpoint before a replacement target or prelude. Failure preserves the journal and blocks new writes.
manualApply.permissions: Replacement recovery preserves startup selection/approval. Explicit user Restore retains its separate startup-disable contract. Background/sign-in commands gain no recovery permission.
manualApply.hpWording: Report the requested HP mode, GPU-flag readback and lack of complete HP thermal-mode readback. CPU Slow/PL1 limit readback or its unavailable reason is separate; it is not measured package power or sustained-power evidence.

presetEditing.cancel: Restore loaded saved baseline including name, per-core values, GPU curve, sign-in checkbox draft and fan snapshot. No storage/hardware/permission write; Reset remains defaults.
presetEditing.fanLibrary: Separate named library; profile copies shared CPU/GPU points, immutable under later library edits/deletion.
presetEditing.requestBoundary: Installed helper only; exact preference originals, checkpoint identity and previous-owner recovery. Direct values verified separately from cooling requested; no curve-digest ACK, BIOS handover or linked sign-in authorization.

narrative.overview:
The Rust/Slint system is a modern, clean Windows utility for frequent hardware checks and careful editing. Discord-inspired Slate neutrals, a restrained indigo accent and Antigravity-style appearance choices give the workbench one shared system.

Measured GPU watts and temperature lead, with verified CPU telemetry beside them; editable presets follow in the same work area. Native editing, alignment, readable fields and explicit actions distinguish selected intent, draft edits, metadata saves and confirmed hardware state.

The UI remains native and offline. Product and hardware contracts stay authoritative; visual corrections establish no new hardware, startup, resource or lifecycle qualification.

A custom native caption and persistent sidebar surround the same mounted editors. Standard HP modes sit above Presets. Bounded notifications replace only the former status/error strip, while bottom actions and explicit Save/Apply remain. Latest manual intent follows safe completion and verified recovery boundaries.

Bounded content is centered beside the sidebar; a full-width schematic exposes four independent lighting groups. GPU range/equalize and cancel-to-saved editing preserve explicit draft boundaries. Named fan snapshots distinguish verified direct controls from a requested helper policy.

rules.name: The Shared Palette Rule
rules.body: Reuse semantic theme roles throughout the native UI; do not create separate popup, chart or settings palettes.

rules.name: The Valid Preview Rule
rules.body: Only valid opaque colors meeting source contrast thresholds replace the previous preview; Save persists it.

rules.name: The Exact Value Rule
rules.body: Preserve units, exact numbers and configured/requested/effective/measured distinctions in both languages.

rules.name: The One Work Area Rule
rules.body: Keep instruments and preset editing mounted together; preserve all editor drafts/selection/Undo and retain explicit bottom actions across navigation and window return.

rules.name: The State Before Color Rule
rules.body: Name busy, error, draft, saved, unavailable and confirmed states in text; color reinforces them.

rules.name: The Latest Intent Rule
rules.body: Replace waiting manual targets; let active hardware work finish safely, verify pending recovery before replacement, and ignore obsolete UI completions.

dos: Do retain native Windows behavior, native Slint text editing and visible keyboard focus.
Do distinguish selected intent, drafts, metadata saves and confirmed hardware readback.
Do keep bounded telemetry, expected-state checks, readback and recovery.
Do verify both languages, compact/enlarged clients, popup scrolling/focus, both renderers, drafts/Undo and palette recovery.
Do isolate developer-only MCP and marked fixtures from the live user store.
Do measure total tray resources including resident helpers; keep results in Validation.
Do retain caption move/resize/system-menu behavior, sidebar geometry and bottom action bars.
Do preserve Save/Discard/Cancel switching and return focus from selectable notification details.
Do inspect actual shown client pixels before an MCP snapshot on window return.
Do distinguish requested HP mode, limited GPU/CPU-limit readback and measured performance.
donts: Don't infer sensor readings or call Windows MHz a measured boost clock.
Don't present previews, saves, palette changes or fixtures as firmware operations.
Don't describe keyboard groups as per-key RGB or numpad-only control.
Don't add a browser runtime, raster decoration, downloaded fonts, decorative motion or continuous rendering.
Don't infer new hardware support, 85 °C enforcement, HP-controller independence, physical DPI transition or complete accessibility qualification from visual corrections.
Don't replace action bars when removing the status/error strip.
Don't recreate editor models or add an idle/full repaint loop to repair software restore.
Don't kill an active controller or silently grant background/startup recovery permission.
